Fallas Festival
• When: from March 15 to 19
• Where: Valencia, Spain
• Activities: parades and fireworks, burning the fallas ⓐ ______ the last day of the festival

Midsummer Festival
• When: from the Friday evening ⓑ ______ June 19 and 25 to the Sunday
• Where: Sweden
• Activities: decorating a tall pole ⓒ ______ flowers and green leaves, traditional dances around the pole

Day of the Dead Festival
• When: November 1 and 2
• Where: Mexico
• Activities: setting up altars in homes and having parties in cemeteries, dressing up ⓓ ______ skeletons and holding big parades

Fur Rondy Festival
• When: ⓔ ______ the end of February
• Where: Alaska, USA
• Activities: various winter sports and Alaskan traditional games, special events such as the Running of the Reindeer
